requirements.label: Academic routes to the research master’s
requirements.details: The routes are a postgraduate diploma at GPA 3.00 or above or a recognised equivalent, a bachelor’s at GPA 3.5, an honours bachelor’s at GPA 3.00 from a recognised institution, or a coursework master’s.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Engineering and Technical Vocational Education and Training · pp. 81

requirements.label: Academic routes to the doctorate
requirements.details: Present a research master’s, a coursework master’s at GPA 4.0 or higher plus a research methods course, or an honours bachelor’s at GPA 4.0 or higher or with first- or upper-second-class honours. Qualifications must be from a recognised institution.
